data.content: P4 IMPLEMENTED at 0b121d3f7 (branch knots-iac-p4-antispam-liveness off main cbe88a313, pushed). (1) ANTI-SPAM at the store choke point (sendMessage — no tool path can bypass): per-pair 20/10min + per-sender 60/10min windowed caps (denial-ledger actor-keyed pattern; rate-state.json under the store lock), urgent bypasses THROTTLE only; consecutive-frame de-dup (same pair+body across conversations — dedupKey cannot catch); hop>=maxHops drops DURABLY to dead-letter (outbox audit + deadletter evidence, never inbox, still counted vs caps so storms cannot evade); TTL expiry-at-read -> durable 'expired' (signature-safe: deliveryState outside signing view); dedup fold-in remains FIRST (idempotent resend is not spam). (2) waiting-on-peer first-class non-settled state (mirrors permission-waiting): escalate marks the sender's hive worker (withHiveLock; hiveless -> senderMarkedWaiting:false), mediate restores idle + fresh idleSince; replies inherit hop budget (hop+1/maxHops) and a reply that dies at the bound returns success:false reply-dead-lettered (escalation stays un-acked, worker stays waiting — no false mediation success). (3) Watcher scripts/hive-watcher.cjs: waitingOnPeerWorkerIds content-matched vs the message store; allComplete now requires waitingOnPeerCount===0; added require.main guard + module.exports (bare require no longer starts the daemon). (4) REAPER CARVE-OUT IS DATA-DRIVEN: protected hive-cleanup.cjs selects status==='idle' only; waiting workers structurally spared — PROVEN against the real protected reaper as a subprocess (oldest-clock waiting worker survives; exactly the oldest stale-idle worker reclaimed under the MIN_WORKERS floor). ZERO protected-file changes this slice. (5) Bridge: never folds a TTL-expired message. Gates: tsc clean, build pass, mcp-tools 531/531 (31 files; 521+10... new antispam 7 + liveness 3, router reworked in place), providers 975/975 post-build (initial 21 fails were the known clean:dist race — rerun clean), private-guard clean, diff-check clean, files text.
